name: Backfill material of RC trench
handbook: Code of Practice on Sewerage and Sanitary Works
section: Annex A - Requirements for Construction of RC Trench
sourceFile: Capability Testing Pack/Annex A - The rules/SSW Annex A (a).docx
description: The RC trench shall comply with the following requirements: It shall be backfilled with sand or other approved granular material.

interpretation.targetElement: RC Trench specifically -- see elementType gate in src/rules/types.ts (requireElementType), same as Annex A(c)
interpretation.verdictLogic: NEEDS_REVIEW if elementType isn't 'RC Trench' (see Annex A(c) reasoning -- same terminology gap applies here). Otherwise NEEDS_REVIEW if no backfill material was read. Otherwise COMPLIANT if the material is in the approved list, NON_COMPLIANT if not.

sampleScenarios.description: Sand is used as the backfill material inside of RC trench.
Soil is used as the backfill material inside of RC trench.

matchedPlanElement.note: Same two 'RC Sump' elements as Annex A(c). Neither is labelled 'RC Trench', and neither has a backfill material annotated anywhere on the drawing -- this rule resolves to NEEDS_REVIEW for a compounded reason: wrong element type AND missing data, either one of which alone would already be enough.
